title: Sealing Room
description: Explains when to seal a room (chemical releases) and when not to (radiation, fire, tornadoes), and why chemical shelters go above ground while radiation shelters go to the basement or center. Gives room selection, materials, a step-by-step sealing procedure, air and time limits, and unsealing after the all-clear.
shortDescription: For chemical releases: pick an above-ground room, seal it, know the time limits
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
